analysis.title: Risk Control Selling Likely Early This Week Before A Subsequent US Equity Recovery
key_insights: UBS (Rebecca Cheong, 11/1) estimates Risk Control funds will sell $75-100bn of equities on Monday, which could add downside pressure and trigger the remaining NQ1 CTA close sell triggers.
Risk Control may sell more on Tuesday only if SPX falls more than 2% on Monday. Otherwise systematic selling from Risk Control and CTAs should fade, which UBS says sets up another sharp recovery.

Friday's excess sell flow was small relative to the index moves: Nasdaq excess sell flow was -$8bn with QQQ -3.5%, and S&P 500 excess sell flow was -$24bn with SPY -1.8%. UBS reads this as systematic selling largely offset by bargain-hunting demand.

Late-day excess flow reversed to +$72bn of buying from 2:45pm, consistent with aggressive UBS RMM buying. Retail bought the dip, mostly in Tech ETFs and Semis/Memory stocks, among Friday's worst-performing segments.

CTA selling is close to exhaustion. Ten sell triggers were crossed Friday across ES1, NQ1 and RTY1, and exposures are now at the 19th, 13th and 15th percentile vs 3Y. Only NQ1 keeps 3 close sell triggers, while ES1 and RTY1 triggers are farther away and less clustered.

Friday's morning flow included $17bn of moderate excess selling from CTA triggers and UBS RMM selling. A further $33bn of sharp excess selling in 30 minutes from 12:45pm to 1:15pm was a knee-jerk reaction to news on Anthropic not getting IG.
Between 1:45pm and 2:30pm there was $46bn of steady excess selling from CTA triggers, partial Risk Control selling of $40-50bn and leveraged ETF selling of $30bn.

UBS RMM clients bought the dip again, with net flow at the 66th percentile vs 3Y, and have bought the dip in 7 of 10 days so far in October. They bought Tech ETFs (XLK, QQQ, SOX and leveraged versions) and Semis/Memory stocks, and sold Software and IT Services stocks and Healthcare (Biotech).

The rotation from tech stocks to tech ETFs was partly year-end tax-loss harvesting, but buy dollars exceeded sell dollars, which UBS says implies some new net buying once leverage in leveraged ETFs is counted.
Risk Control needed to sell an estimated $115-150bn after SPX -1.82% Friday: $40-50bn on Friday and $75-100bn on Monday. After Monday's rebalance, Risk Control exposure falls from 111% to 95%.
Leveraged and inverse ETP rebalance is -$30.1bn to sell, of which -$27bn is in Nasdaq and tech and -$2.4bn in other broad-based indexes.
risk_factors: Monday Risk Control selling of $75-100bn could deepen the equity decline and trigger the remaining NQ1 CTA close sell triggers.
A Monday SPX drop of more than 2% would bring further Risk Control selling on Tuesday.
Leveraged ETP rebalancing adds $27bn of selling in Nasdaq and tech, concentrated in semiconductor names.
vol_and_positioning: Risk Control Monday selling scenarios: SPX -3% means $195-230bn sold, SPX -2% means $105-120bn, SPX -1.5% means $55-65bn, SPX -1% means about $15bn.
Risk Control exposure drops from 111% to 95% after Monday's rebalance. Tuesday selling is meaningful only if SPX drops more than 2%.
ES1 CTA exposure is at the 19th percentile vs 3Y, with 4 close buy triggers (7690.1, 7732.9, 7738.3, 7782.5) and 1 close sell trigger at 7556.5 (-0.8%).
NQ1 CTA exposure is at the 13th percentile vs 3Y, with 2 close sell triggers at 28036 (-1.8%) and no close buy trigger. The first buy trigger is +4.0% away.
RTY1 CTA exposure is at the 15th percentile vs 3Y, with 1 sell trigger crossed Friday and no close buy or sell triggers within 2%.
Leveraged ETP rebalance top 10 stocks to sell in dollars: NVDA, AMD, MU, AVGO, INTC, AAPL, MSFT, TXN, ADI, QCOM.
Leveraged ETP rebalance top 10 stocks to sell as % of ADV: NXPI, ADI, MPWR, MCHP, TXN, QCOM, KLAC, TER, ON, ALAB.

tension_points.bull_case: Minimal excess sell flow, strong retail dip buying and CTA selling near exhaustion point to a sharp recovery once Monday's Risk Control selling is absorbed.
tension_points.bear_case: Risk Control sells $75-100bn Monday and could trigger the remaining NQ1 CTA sell triggers, adding downside pressure early in the week.
tension_points.what_invalidates: An SPX drop of more than 2% on Monday would bring more meaningful Risk Control selling on Tuesday.
